- 📝 **Docs** — Refined README in two further edits

- 🧪 **Verify** — Ran full pipeline; found multi-line intents breaking quote blocks and repeated intents

✅ **Outcome:** Shell write commands now count as edits; 32 tests documented; change committed.

### Decisions

- **Direct session-to-commit linking** — Git AI isn't installed on this machine.
- **Git notes plus pre-push auto-share** — Shares Commit Context without altering commit contents.
- **Background summarization, guaranteed at push** — `claude -p` takes 10-30s and shouldn't block commits.
- **OpenAI key for Actions summaries** — No Anthropic API key available to the developer for CI.
- **Fall back to OpenAI only when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise to the heuristic** — Keeps the tool working offline without a key.
- **Log background summarize stderr to the log file** — Failures were previously silent, which hid the claude -p problem.
- **Mark carried prompts with carried:true rather than counting them as new prompts** — Keeps stats accurate while still giving the reviewer the instruction's context.
- **Put architecture, differentiators, design decisions and test results in the README** — A demo video can't show all of them
- **Dedupe intents after whitespace normalization in template mode** — Heuristic mode repeated the same intent across commits
- **Heuristic regex plus path substring match to detect shell edits** — Cheap and good enough to catch sed -i, heredocs and scripts without parsing shell syntax

## ③ Show the PR as a flow of prompt chunks

⏱ 10m · 💬 1 prompt · 🤖 23 AI steps · 📄 11 files · commits `26cd440` `df26765`

### 🧑‍💻 Prompt

> 대화 자체는 길이가 너무 길어질 수 있지만, 그 대화를 특정 범주로 요약해서 덩어리의 플로우를 보여주는 건 어느 정도 길이를 예측할 수 있잖아. 너무 길다하면 덩어리 범주를 크게 잡으면 되고. 일단은 시각적으로 해당 pr을 만들기 위해 어떤 프롬프트 덩어리 범주 플로우로 이루어졌는지 보여주면 좋을 것 같아. 이거 좀 더 구체화해보자. 나한테 더 질문해도 좋아.

🌐 English:

> Although the conversation itself can become very long, you can predict the length to some extent by summarizing that conversation into specific categories and showing the chunked flow. If it's too long, make the chunk categories larger. For now, it would be good to visually show which prompt chunk-category flow composed the creation of the PR. Let's make this more concrete. Feel free to ask me more questions.

### 🤖 What the AI did

- 🧭 **Plan** — Asked four scoping questions about categories, shape, details and limits
- 🛠️ **Build** — Added Phase types, phases.ts grouping and flow.ts Mermaid renderer
- 🛠️ **Build** — Wired phases into summarize and report output
- 🐛 **Fix** — Fixed truncate-before-redact ordering after a test leaked a secret
- 🧪 **Verify** — Ran build and 44 tests; regenerated all commit notes
- 🔍 **Investigate** — Previewed the flow section locally; noticed wrapper tags in captured prompts
- 🐛 **Fix** — Strip pasted_content tags from prompt text in parseSessionLog
- 🧪 **Verify** — Added a test for wrapper stripping; ran the suite
- 📝 **Docs** — Bumped test count in README to 45
- 🚀 **Ship** — Committed and regenerated affected notes

✅ **Outcome:** Wrappers stripped; 45 tests pass; flow preview showed 18 chunks from 8 commits.

### Decisions

- **Fixed types plus free-form fallback categories** — Consistent visuals while allowing atypical work to be labelled
- **Flowchart with commit markers** — Renders natively on GitHub and ties chunks to commits
- **Show representative prompt and decisions with reasons per chunk** — Gives reviewers intent and rationale without full transcripts
- **Max 10 chunks, single chronological flow** — Bounds length regardless of session count or conversation size
- **Strip the tags in the session parser, not at render time.** — The cleaned text then feeds every downstream use, including summaries and flow grouping.
- **Strip the tags in the session parser, not at render time.** — The cleaned text then feeds every downstream use, including summaries and flow grouping.

## ⑤ Chunk PR flow by developer prompt, not agent action

⏱ 14m · 💬 1 prompt · 🤖 36 AI steps · 📄 17 files · commits `5175516` `9ddbbdb` `590f7b1`

### 🧑‍💻 Prompt

> fix, build 등 범주를 나눌 때 에이전트의 행동을 기준으로 삼지 않고 사용자 프롬프트를 기준으로 삼아줘. 사용자 프롬프트 입력했을 때 에이전트가 build, fix 등등 여러 범주의 작업을 수행했다면 이를 하나의 덩어리로 보여줘. 즉, ai 에이전트의 행동 플로우를 단순 정리하는 게 아니라 사용자 프롬프트로부터 ai가 어떤 과정을 수행했는지 요약하는거지. 
>
> ui나 디테일적인 측면에서 애매하거나 디벨롭 할만한 게 있으면 나한테 다시 질문해. 
> 그리고 아마 이런 ai가 무슨 일을 하는지 요약해서 보여주는 실제 서비스가 아마 있을거야. 이거 참고해서 도움될만한 부분은 차용해서 해보자.

🌐 English:

> When dividing categories like fix, build, etc., use the user's prompt as the basis, not the agent's actions. If the agent performed multiple category tasks (build, fix, etc.) in response to a single user prompt input, show that as a single chunk. In other words, don't simply summarize the AI agent's action flow; summarize what process the AI performed starting from the user's prompt.
>
> If there are ambiguous UI or detail aspects or things to develop further, ask me again.
>
> Also, there is probably an existing service that summarizes what this kind of AI does. Let's reference that and borrow any helpful parts.

### 🤖 What the AI did

- 🔍 **Investigate** — Researched services that summarize AI agent work and asked UI questions
- ♻️ **Refactor** — Replaced Phase type with Turn; added turns.ts and removed phases.ts
- 🛠️ **Build** — Rewrote flow.ts to render one node per request with chips, metrics, tips
- 🧪 **Verify** — Type-checked, rewrote flow tests, ran 47 passing tests
- 🚀 **Ship** — Committed and regenerated all notes in the new turn structure
- 🛠️ **Build** — Normalize step types via synonym map in turns.ts
- 🛠️ **Build** — Track per-piece outcomes and fold steps longer than 8 in flow.ts
- 🛠️ **Build** — Request whole-request outcomes in the OpenAI synthesis and apply them in report
- 🧪 **Verify** — Ran 49 tests and checked the Mermaid render in a local preview
- 🚀 **Ship** — Committed, pushed, and waited for the workflow
- 🔍 **Investigate** — Found an extra session linked to the commit and the command that matched
- 🐛 **Fix** — Narrowed SHELL_WRITE_RE to ignore 2&gt;/dev/null, 2&gt;&1 and read-only interpreters
- 🧪 **Verify** — Added 6 parameterized shell-write tests; build and run 55 tests
- 📝 **Docs** — Updated README test counts to 55
- 🚀 **Ship** — Committed fix and regenerated 9ddbbdb note without the extra session

✅ **Outcome:** Regex narrowed; 55 tests pass; commit note regenerated without the false session link.

### Decisions

- **Merge same-intent follow-up prompts into one turn** — Avoids a node per short nudge
- **Step chips plus one-line outcome per turn** — Compact view of what the AI did
- **English intent title, original prompt in details** — Report is English while prompts are Korean
- **Adopt Devin-style prompt tips (including positives) and turn efficiency metrics** — Helps developers reinforce good prompting habits and see per-request effort
- **Rewrite each request's outcome over the whole request via the PR-level LLM synthesis** — A per-commit outcome only reflects the last piece of a multi-commit request
- **Treat only redirects to real files and explicit write calls as shell writes** — Stderr redirects and read-only python/node commands caused false session-to-commit links
- **Rewrite each request's outcome over the whole request via the PR-level LLM synthesis** — A per-commit outcome only reflects the last piece of a multi-commit request
- **Treat only redirects to real files and explicit write calls as shell writes** — Stderr redirects and read-only python/node commands caused false session-to-commit links

### 🎯 Prompt review

- 👍 **Keep:** Asked the agent to research real services and to ask back about ambiguous UI/detail choices before building.
- 👍 **Keep:** Clearly contrasted the desired model (summarize AI work per user prompt) with the old action-based grouping.
- 💡 **Try:** Specify the desired layout (straight line, node width) up front; later rounds went to GitHub rendering tweaks.
